Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to kick off vendor onboarding — we need Redwood to be visible in our Ariba supplier list and we'd like to finalize the MSA + initial order form so we can issue the first PO.

Quick context and asks:
- We are onboarding through Ariba (supplier portal) and need Redwood's company info, remit details, and your Ariba supplier ID (if you have one).
- Our legal team reviewed the MSA and sent a redline (attached). Can your legal team review and indicate which changes you can accept?
- The order form needs a billing contact, currency (USD), and PO rules (net30).

Can we aim to have the portal registration complete and a signed order form within two weeks?

Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & MSA questions

Jose — I reviewed the redline you attached. High-level: we accept most of the commercial edits but need to discuss three items that impact our platform risk profile and uptime obligations.

Key points needing alignment: 
1) Liability cap — your redline reduces our proposed cap to $250k; Redwood's standard is the greater of $X or 2x MRR. We can propose a middle ground tied to the order form value for the first year.
2) Data deletion and retention — we need to preserve short-term KV cache behaviour for inference; a 7-day minimum SLA for cache flush is standard for us.
3) SLA credits — we can provide credits but not full termination rights tied solely to latency. We propose a 99.5% uptime SLO with credits on breaches.

I’ve attached an inline redline (Redwood_MSA_redline_20260712.pdf) with comments. Happy to join a call to walk through.

– Dev Patel
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.ai
From: Jose Garcia <jose.garcia@medtechsolutions.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>; Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@medtechsolutions.com>, Elena Wu <elena.wu@medtechsolutions.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & MSA questions

Dev — thanks for the quick review and clear bullets. Our GC, Elena Wu, asked me to confirm a few things before a call:
- Are you able to accept a liability cap equal to 1x annualized fees for the first year?
- For data retention: we need written assurance that any customer data (including logs) can be deleted on request within 14 days. Is that feasible?
- Regarding the Ariba portal: we are starting vendor registration today; the portal asks for a supplier legal name, tax ID, and a contact person. Our AP lead is melissa.carter@medtechsolutions.com.

We can do a quick 30-min call this afternoon at 3pm PT if that works for your legal lead.

Thanks,
Jose
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jose Garcia <jose.garcia@medtechsolutions.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 15:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding & MSA questions

Jose — we can accept 1x annualized fees for the first year as a concession; please have Elena confirm in writing. Regarding data deletion: operational logs are retained for audit purposes for 30 days by default, but we will commit to a documented deletion/escrow procedure for customer-provided data within 14 days where feasible; we will add exceptions for ephemeral system telemetry and legal hold. I’ll draft precise language and send a narrow redline.

I’m available for a 3pm PT call. Marcus / Laura — please share the Ariba registration details and the order form so we can walk through PO fields on the call.

– Dev

2) Ariba registration: Laura to complete supplier profile and confirm supplier ID + remit info to melissa.carter@medtechsolutions.com by EOD Wed (2026-07-15).
3) Order form: Marcus to send signed-ready order form (billing contact, net30, PO field mapping) — will attach the draft to the DocuSign link in the related_links above.
4) Procurement: Jose / MedTech to open the PO once registration and order form are final; target first PO issuance by Tue (2026-07-20).
